dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual convex narrowing of the 2D geometric mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light-grey skin tone with high median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey mottling patches visible on the cephalic region and along the mid-dorsal flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the slightly pigmented grey areas and the near-white baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast circular aperture (blowhole) on the dorsal cephalic plane; several faint, light-colored linear striations on the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, light-colored linear markings on the mid-dorsal surface, potentially representing healed rake marks or superficial abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced and straight longitudinal dorsal ridge extending along the central axis toward the posterior.
